title: Stable Density on Subspaces
exact_target: Determine how small a codimension guarantees a linear subspace on which the density of any given binary-vector-space set is stable under passing to every hyperplane.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 143 (GREEN-055). CC BY 4.0.
